INFINITE-AI · BRAND GUIDELINES · v1.0 · 13 November 2026

Brand guidelines

EDUCATE - INNOVATE - TRANSFORM

1. The logo

The logo is a glowing infinity loop, wired to neurons, above the word INFINITE-AI. It was supplied as one square artwork on a deep-space background. Use the file as supplied: icons/profile_logo_square_1080.png.

Do
  • Place it on Deep Space, Midnight, or a dark photo.
  • On white paper, keep it inside its rounded dark square, as on the letterhead.
  • Keep clear space of at least one tenth of its width on every side.
  • Keep it at or above 24 mm in print, or 90 px on screen.
Do not
  • Stretch, rotate, recolour or add effects.
  • Put it straight onto white, or onto a busy or bright background.
  • Redraw it, or rebuild the wordmark in another typeface.
  • Use it smaller than the minimum size.

2. Tagline

EDUCATE - INNOVATE - TRANSFORM

Written in capitals, in this order, with spaces and hyphens as shown. Set in Space Grotesk bold with wide letter-spacing, or as a Cyan to Violet gradient on dark.

3. Colour

Deep Space#05070FRGB 5, 7, 15CMYK 67, 53, 0, 94Backgrounds, dark mode
Midnight#0C1224RGB 12, 18, 36CMYK 67, 50, 0, 86Panels and cards
Plasma Cyan#5BC8ECRGB 91, 200, 236CMYK 61, 15, 0, 7Primary accent, links on dark
Neural Violet#8D6CFFRGB 141, 108, 255CMYK 45, 58, 0, 0Secondary accent
Spark Gold#F5B841RGB 245, 184, 65CMYK 0, 25, 73, 4Highlights and warnings, used sparingly
Ice White#E9F6FFRGB 233, 246, 255CMYK 9, 4, 0, 0Text on dark
Ink#12162ARGB 18, 22, 42CMYK 57, 48, 0, 84Text on light
Cyan on light#0A6F8FRGB 10, 111, 143CMYK 93, 22, 0, 44Accent text on white paper
Violet on light#4F34D2RGB 79, 52, 210CMYK 62, 75, 0, 18Accent text on white paper

CMYK values are simple conversions for reference. Ask your printer for a proof and match by eye; do not rely on the numbers alone. On light backgrounds use the three light-paper colours; the bright accents do not have enough contrast on white.

4. Typography

UseTypefaceNotes
Headings, taglineSpace GroteskBold for headings, wide spacing for the tagline.
Body textInterRegular and semibold. Arial is the fallback in email.
Labels, codes, contact linesSpace MonoSmall, muted.

5. Founder photograph

Sarah-Jane Harding, Founder

Always circular, with a Plasma Cyan ring. The supplied photo is 360 × 360 px, so use it at 360 px or smaller. A larger copy needs a higher-resolution original. Only the founder and consenting staff appear in brand material. Never use a learner or a child's image.

6. Contact block

Infinite-AI
10 Jellicoe Street, Pinetown
KwaZulu-Natal, 3610, South Africa
+27 611 939 620
infinite-ai-ecosystem@protonmail.com

Use exactly this wording. The province is written with the official spelling, KwaZulu-Natal.

7. Voice

  • Plain, warm, exact. Say what the product does, not what it might one day do.
  • No invented numbers, no invented testimonials, no learner details.
  • AI drafts. The teacher decides. Always.
  • Written for South African schools: South African English, rand amounts, local context.

9. Where the brand lives in the software

The platform reads one file, src/brand.ts, for the name, tagline, address, phone, email, colours and logo. Documents exported from the platform carry the tagline and contact footer. Change the details in that one file and rebuild.
